import pytest
import click
from click.shell_completion import FishComplete
from click.shell_completion import CompletionItem


def test_fish_completion_multiline_help_text():
    @click.command()
    @click.option(
        "--at",
        help="\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg",
    )
    def cli(at):
        pass

    comp = FishComplete(cli, {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE")
    completions = comp.get_completions([], "--at")

    # The expected behavior is that the multiline help text is escaped
    # or otherwise handled so that it doesn't break the fish completion script.
    # For now, we'll assert that the help text is present and correctly formatted
    # as a single line with the description and the example.
    # The actual fix will involve escaping the newlines in the shell_completion.py
    # file, but this test will fail until that happens because the raw multiline
    # text will be passed.
    assert len(completions) == 1
    assert completions[0].value == "--at"
    # The description should be a single line, with newlines replaced by spaces
    # or removed, and the example should be part of it.
    # The current buggy behavior would include actual newlines, which this
    # assertion implicitly checks against by expecting a single string.
    assert (
        completions[0].help
        == "Attachment with explicit mimetype, --at image.jpg image/jpeg"
    )
